name: Michael Burjack
headline: Uncovering what makes people click.
about:
I’m a Senior Staff Developer at Shopify, running engineering for our Growth Labs team.

I've been applying technology-as-a-lever to small, medium, and large businesses for over 25 years. 
 
I am a true full-stack developer (from crimping network cables to authoring CSS+JS to running ETLs and every waypoint in-between), manager, mentor, and entrepreneur. 
 
Specialties include: Performance marketing via TV, SEO, SEM, & social/viral channels; SQL & big data analytics and storytelling, data visualization and custom reporting; business workflow modeling; process management; database schema design; technology process architecture.
… more

experiences.description:
I am a Principal Software Engineer currently contributing to the Traffic Acquisition Team (Ottawa).

TripAdvisor has the largest, most experienced & advanced team of white-hat SEO & SEM professionals anywhere. Operating on over 60 websites across more than 25 languages, reaching over 390 million average monthly uniques and serving more than 500 million reviews and opinions covering 7 million accommodations, there's no better, bigger place to practise my craft.

Previously, as the SEM Engineering Lead for TripAdvisor TripWow, I created global high-ROI brand exposure with a viral loop twist.

Previously, I worked on refactoring and rebuilding parts of TravelPod — the world's first travel blogging platform — a TAMG group company.
Dragonfli provides managed support and professional services for small business web hosting, IMAP email hosting, and domain portfolio management.
Tool-based web sales and marketing systems; standards-compliant web frameworks, "Web 2.0"-style web application development; web management systems integration, 120-point web audit consulting.
